name: E-bikes
question: Which published bike specifications fit your shortlist?

filters.label: Class as stated by [brand]
filters.hint: Compare the class explicitly stated by the brand.
filters.edge_case: Do not infer class from speed or motor power.

filters.label: Battery
filters.edge_case: Calculate Wh from V × Ah only with both published inputs.

filters.label: Bike weight
filters.edge_case: Note with or without battery; incompatible measurements are Measured differently.

filters.label: Motor
filters.edge_case: Use explicit manufacturer descriptions; no motor-watt filter.

display_fields.label: Brand range estimate
display_fields.edge_case: Always use Brand estimate; retain the stated conditions.

explainer.title: Why a range estimate is not a promise
explainer.text: Range depends on terrain, load, assistance level and conditions. Manufacturer estimates are shown for context and excluded from filters and sorting.

notes: State laws vary. Check local rules.
